metric.formula: DTI = T / (alpha*(T+F) + beta*G); emit binary (R1); marginal rule dT > alpha*DTI*dF/(1-alpha*DTI) (R2)

calibration_truth.note: the catalogue the supervised files trained on; an in-domain monitor, not a generalisation test, and degenerate for candidates that exploit the mask

priced.note: chargeable_px is the false-positive mass a score of 0 would pay for; the rule says those pixels are worth emitting only where their expected hit rate exceeds the required_marginal_hit_rate at the operating point
